## Notes

Morale from timed buffs (Mess Hall +3, Banquet Hall +6, Private Bedroom +3; food up to +16; decor up to +12); expectation rises with skills learned; each point under adds 2.5% stress per cycle up to 25%; 2 or more over reduces stress 20% per cycle; overjoyed responses from 8 points over.
